arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# 1996 New Aa municipal bond yields
yields = [5.41, 5.41, 5.57, 5.72, 5.73, 5.82, 5.82, 5.69, 5.62, 5.53, 5.47, 5.47]

# Calculate log returns (continuously compounded)
log_returns = []
for i in range(1, len(yields)):
    r = math.log(yields[i] / yields[i-1])
    log_returns.append(r)
    print(f"{i}: {yields[i-1]:.2f} -> {yields[i]:.2f}, log return = {r:.6f}")

print(f"\nTotal log returns: {len(log_returns)}")
print(f"Log returns: {log_returns}")

# Sort for percentile calculation
sorted_returns = sorted(log_returns)
print(f"Sorted: {sorted_returns}")

# Nearest-rank method for 5th percentile
# Rank = ceil(p * n) where p = 0.05 and n = number of observations
n = len(log_returns)
rank = math.ceil(0.05 * n)
print(f"\nn = {n}, rank = ceil(0.05 * {n}) = {rank}")

# Get the value at that rank (1-indexed, so subtract 1)
percentile_value = sorted_returns[rank - 1]
print(f"5th percentile (worst) return: {percentile_value}")

# VaR as percentage loss
var_percentage = abs(percentile_value) * 100
print(f"\nVaR = {var_percentage:.2f}%")
EOF
